Write a detailed 1200 to 1500 word volunteer handbook with at least eight titled sections covering intake, sorting, labelling, storage, lending, returns, germination testing and safety. State this exact codename once in the introduction. Include your saved byline.
requests.join: Write a 60 to 120 word update for volunteers using ONLY the two selected completed artifacts. State the exact total number of seed packets from the math specialist result in decimal digits, and the exact heirloom codename from the volunteer note. Never guess either value. End with your saved byline. Return the update directly.
